name: Imperial Hotel, Tokyo
positioning: City hotel in Hibiya, Tokyo, with rooms in a Main Building and a Tower Building, a short distance from Ginza and Marunouchi
best_for: Travelers who want a central base near Ginza and Marunouchi
Guests interested in the Frank Lloyd Wright design legacy

facts.text: The hotel is a short distance from the shopping and theater districts of Ginza and Marunouchi.
The hotel is a 3-minute walk from Hibiya Station.
The Imperial Floors occupy the 14th to 16th floors of the Main Building.
Rooms on the Imperial Floors feature Sleep Works beds.
Tower Building guest rooms are on the 20th to 31st floors, suited to guests who want night views.
The pool and sauna are on the 20th floor of the Tower Building.
The fitness center is exclusively for hotel guests.
Les Saisons serves fine French cuisine in the Main Building.
The Old Imperial Bar is in the Main Building.
In Kamon's private room, the chef prepares selected ingredients in front of guests.
Room service accepts orders 24 hours a day.
Imperial Hotel Limousine can handle airport transfers in the middle of the night or first thing in the morning.

highlights.text: The Frank Lloyd Wright Suite reconstructs the design motifs of the hotel's second Main Building, the Wright Building, for contemporary living.
A sound-proof Music Room has a Steinway grand piano for visiting musicians and singers to practice or rehearse.
Tokyo Nadaman's Japanese-style interior is inspired by architect Togo Murano.
Imperial Floor Deluxe Park View rooms have views of Hibiya Park's greenery.
The hotel offers tea-ceremony demonstrations in its tea-ceremony rooms.

considerations.text: The hotel offers barrier-free rooms modified for wheelchair users.
Medical facilities including internal medicine, dentistry and orthopedics are located in the Main Building and the Imperial Tower.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and prime Tokyo location.
